explanation: The Almighty Creator who gives strength through His Spirit to complete His work, independent of human power or wisdom.
God's living power and presence that drives the prophet Zechariah to see the future and give hope for the rebuilding of God's temple.
The purpose of the text is to show that the work is not completed by human strength or ability, but exclusively through God's Spirit.
God gives understanding to those who believe in Him, so that they can look beyond impossible obstacles and trust in His promises.
The temple in Jerusalem which symbolizes God's presence among His people, and which is to be completed despite opposition.
Symbol of the seven eyes of the Lord, representing His all-knowing oversight over the whole earth and ability to see everything.
The tree that provides oil for the lampstand, symbolizing the uninterrupted flow of God's Spirit which is necessary for the temple to be completed.
The great obstacles or hostile powers that stand in the way of rebuilding, but which God will turn into a plain by His power.
